bureau: Credit reference bureaus licensed under the Credit Reference Bureau Act (Registrar of Financial Institutions)
note: The Credit Reference Bureau Act (Cap. 46:09; 18 of 2010 as amended by 6 of 2016), MalawiLII's consolidated text at 31 December 2017 (Fifth Revised Edition, L.R.O. 1/2018), read from archive.org's snapshot of 10 December 2025 (malawilii.org's source document answers with a Cloudflare check); the archive's captures of the Act on MalawiLII list no later version than the 2017 consolidation. Section 21: a credit reference bureau shall maintain a historical database covering a seven-year period for providing detailed credit information: written as keep 7, the period of history a bureau's detailed credit information covers (the Act sets no other period and no deletion rule; this is the game's reading of 'covering a seven year period'). Section 13B (inserted by 6 of 2016): a financial institution updates the credit information it furnishes to the bureaus on a monthly basis, or earlier where an update is necessary, with no threshold: written as reported 30 days after the due date (a monthly cycle). Section 2: the Registrar is the Registrar of Financial Institutions under the Financial Services Act. On 2026-11-03 malawilii.org answered with a Cloudflare check and archive.org didn't answer, so the snapshot keeps its reading of 2026-10-31; the same consolidated text, in Laws.Africa's Legislation Commons PDF (the platform MalawiLII publishes from), was read that day and still says what is quoted. Until 2026-11-03 MalawiLII's page and Laws.Africa's consolidation were cited as primary; both are a legal information institute's copy of the law, so secondary since the ruling of 2026-11-03, so they were relabelled, and the Act as gazetted in 2010, on the Reserve Bank of Malawi's list of legislation, was read that day: s. 21, a historical database covering a seven (7) year period, and s. 2's Registrar, as the consolidation says, so keep stays 7. The monthly update (s. 13B, inserted by Act 6 of 2016) rests on the consolidation alone: the Reserve Bank lists the 2010 Act only, the Ministry of Justice's list doesn't hold the amendment, and Laws.Africa holds no gazette scan of Act 6 of 2016 (404).
